verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a payments merchant of record, so fraud screening is a fair axis for it. The only fraud evidence is a general claim that the vendor handles fraud on the merchant's behalf. Nothing shows machine-learning fraud scores exposed to users, or user-authored block, review, or allow rules.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules
